sentences.en: Cinnamon is a sweet, fragrant spice produced from the inner bark of trees of the genus Cinnamomum, which is native to the Indian sub-continent.
sentences.zh: 肉桂是一种带有甜香气味的香料，取自樟属树木的内层树皮；这种树原产于印度次大陆。

grammar.type: 过去分词定语 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: produced from... 修饰 spice；which is native to... 补充说明 genus Cinnamomum。

sentences.en: It was known in biblical times, and is mentioned in several books of the Bible, both as an ingredient that was mixed with oils for anointing people's bodies, and also as a token indicating friendship among lovers and friends.
sentences.zh: 早在《圣经》时代，人们就知道肉桂；《圣经》中有几卷书都提到它，既把它写成与油混合、用于涂抹身体的配料，也把它当作爱人和朋友之间表达情谊的信物。

grammar.type: 并列被动 + both...and...
grammar.note: was known 与 is mentioned 并列；both as...and also as... 说明肉桂的两种用途；that was mixed... 修饰 ingredient。

sentences.en: In ancient Rome, mourners attending funerals burnt cinnamon to create a pleasant scent.
sentences.zh: 在古罗马，参加葬礼的哀悼者会燃烧肉桂，让现场产生宜人的香气。

grammar.type: 现在分词定语 + 不定式目的状语
grammar.note: attending funerals 修饰 mourners；to create... 说明燃烧肉桂的目的。

sentences.en: Most often, however, the spice found its primary use as an additive to food and drink.
sentences.zh: 不过，肉桂最主要的用途还是作为食品和饮料的添加物。

grammar.type: 简单句 + 插入语
grammar.note: however 为转折插入语；find its use as... 表示“被用作……”。

sentences.en: In the Middle Ages, Europeans who could afford the spice used it to flavour food, particularly meat, and to impress those around them with their ability to purchase an expensive condiment from the ‘exotic’ East.
sentences.zh: 中世纪时，买得起肉桂的欧洲人用它给食物调味，尤其是肉类；他们还借此向周围的人显示，自己有能力购买来自“异域”东方的昂贵调味品。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 并列不定式
grammar.note: who could afford the spice 修饰 Europeans；to flavour 与 to impress 并列，说明 used it 的两个目的。

sentences.en: At a banquet, a host would offer guests a plate with various spices piled upon it as a sign of the wealth at his or her disposal.
sentences.zh: 宴会上，主人会端给客人一只堆放着各种香料的盘子，以此显示自己拥有的财富。

grammar.type: with 复合结构 + 介词短语
grammar.note: with various spices piled upon it 修饰 a plate；as a sign of... 表示这样做所传达的含义。

words.def: 可供某人使用；由某人支配

sentences.en: Cinnamon was also reported to have health benefits, and was thought to cure various ailments, such as indigestion.
sentences.zh: 据说肉桂还有保健作用，并被认为可以治疗消化不良等多种疾病。

grammar.type: 并列被动 + 不定式
grammar.note: was reported to have 与 was thought to cure 为两个并列的被动结构；such as 引出例子。

sentences.en: Toward the end of the Middle Ages, the European middle classes began to desire the lifestyle of the elite, including their consumption of spices.
sentences.zh: 中世纪末期，欧洲中产阶级开始向往上层阶级的生活方式，其中也包括他们消费香料的习惯。

grammar.type: begin to do + 介词短语
grammar.note: began to desire 为主句谓语；including... 补充 lifestyle of the elite 的具体内容。

sentences.en: This led to a growth in demand for cinnamon and other spices.
sentences.zh: 这使人们对肉桂和其他香料的需求增加。

grammar.type: lead to + 名词
grammar.note: This 指代上一句的社会变化；lead to 表示“导致”，to 为介词。

sentences.en: At that time, cinnamon was transported by Arab merchants, who closely guarded the secret of the source of the spice from potential rivals.
sentences.zh: 当时，肉桂由阿拉伯商人运输，他们严密保守香料产地的秘密，不让潜在竞争者知道。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: was transported 为被动；who... 补充说明 Arab merchants；guard...from... 表示防止信息落入他人之手。

sentences.en: They took it from India, where it was grown, on camels via an overland route to the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 他们用骆驼把产自印度的肉桂沿陆路运到地中海地区。

grammar.type: where 定语从句 + 方式状语
grammar.note: where it was grown 补充说明 India；on camels 和 via an overland route 都说明运输方式。

sentences.en: Their journey ended when they reached Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 他们抵达亚历山大港后，这段陆路行程便结束了。

grammar.type: when 时间状语从句
grammar.note: 主句为 Their journey ended；when 从句说明结束的时间。

sentences.en: European traders sailed there to purchase their supply of cinnamon, then brought it back to Venice.
sentences.zh: 欧洲商人航行到那里购买肉桂，随后再把肉桂运回威尼斯。

grammar.type: 不定式目的状语 + 并列谓语
grammar.note: to purchase... 说明 sailed there 的目的；sailed 与 brought 为先后发生的两个动作。

sentences.en: The spice then travelled from that great trading city to markets all around Europe.
sentences.zh: 肉桂随后从这座重要的贸易城市运往欧洲各地的市场。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: from...to... 交代香料运输的起点和目的地。

sentences.en: Because the overland trade route allowed for only small quantities of the spice to reach Europe, and because Venice had a virtual monopoly of the trade, the Venetians could set the price of cinnamon exorbitantly high.
sentences.zh: 由于陆路贸易只能把少量肉桂运到欧洲，而且威尼斯实际上垄断了这项贸易，威尼斯人便可以把肉桂价格定得极高。

grammar.type: 两个 because 原因从句
grammar.note: 两个 because 从句并列说明原因；主句 the Venetians could set... 给出结果；set the price high 为宾语加补语。

sentences.en: These prices, coupled with the increasing demand, spurred the search for new routes to Asia by Europeans eager to take part in the spice trade.
sentences.zh: 高昂的价格加上不断增长的需求，促使渴望参与香料贸易的欧洲人寻找通往亚洲的新航线。

grammar.type: 过去分词插入语 + 形容词短语定语
grammar.note: coupled with... 补充主语 These prices；eager to take part... 修饰 Europeans；spur 表示“促使”。

sentences.en: Seeking the high profits promised by the cinnamon market, Portuguese traders arrived on the island of Ceylon in the Indian Ocean toward the end of the 15th century.
sentences.zh: 为了获取肉桂市场所带来的高额利润，葡萄牙商人在15世纪末抵达印度洋上的锡兰岛。

grammar.type: 现在分词目的状语 + 过去分词定语
grammar.note: Seeking... 表示到达锡兰的目的；promised by the cinnamon market 修饰 high profits。

sentences.en: Before Europeans arrived on the island, the state had organized the cultivation of cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人来到岛上之前，当地政府已经组织起肉桂种植。

grammar.type: before 时间从句 + 过去完成时
grammar.note: Before 从句给出时间参照；had organized 表示该行动在欧洲人到达前已经完成。

sentences.en: People belonging to the ethnic group called the Salagama would peel the bark off young shoots of the cinnamon plant in the rainy season, when the wet bark was more pliable.
sentences.zh: 雨季时，萨拉伽马族人会剥下肉桂嫩枝的树皮，因为此时湿润的树皮更柔韧，便于处理。

grammar.type: 分词定语 + when 定语从句
grammar.note: belonging to... 和 called... 都修饰 People；when... 补充说明 rainy season；would 表示过去经常进行的动作。

sentences.en: During the peeling process, they curled the bark into the ‘stick’ shape still associated with the spice today.
sentences.zh: 剥皮过程中，他们把树皮卷成条状，也就是今天人们仍会联想到肉桂的形状。

grammar.type: 过去分词定语
grammar.note: associated with the spice today 修饰 the ‘stick’ shape；curl...into... 表示“把……卷成……”。

sentences.en: The Salagama then gave the finished product to the king as a form of tribute.
sentences.zh: 萨拉伽马族人随后把成品交给国王，作为贡品。

grammar.type: give 双宾语 + as 短语
grammar.note: gave the finished product to the king 为 give sth to sb；as a form of tribute 说明用途。

sentences.en: When the Portuguese arrived, they needed to increase production significantly, and so enslaved many other members of the Ceylonese native population, forcing them to work in cinnamon harvesting.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人到来后需要大幅提高产量，于是奴役了许多锡兰原住民，强迫他们采收肉桂。

grammar.type: when 时间从句 + 现在分词结果状语
grammar.note: needed 与 enslaved 为主句中的先后动作；forcing them to work... 说明奴役造成的结果。

sentences.en: In 1518, the Portuguese built a fort on Ceylon, which enabled them to protect the island, so helping them to develop a monopoly in the cinnamon trade and generate very high profits.
sentences.zh: 1518年，葡萄牙人在锡兰修建了一座堡垒，使他们能够守住岛屿，并由此垄断肉桂贸易，赚取高额利润。

grammar.type: 非限制性定语从句 + 分词结果状语
grammar.note: which 指代修建堡垒这件事；enable sb to do 表示“使某人能够做”；so helping... 说明进一步结果。

sentences.en: In the late 16th century, for example, they enjoyed a tenfold profit when shipping cinnamon over a journey of eight days from Ceylon to India.
sentences.zh: 例如在16世纪末，他们把肉桂从锡兰运到印度，航程只有八天，却能获得十倍利润。

grammar.type: when 省略从句
grammar.note: when shipping... 相当于 when they shipped...；tenfold 表示“十倍的”。

sentences.en: When the Dutch arrived off the coast of southern Asia at the very beginning of the 17th century, they set their sights on displacing the Portuguese as kings of cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 17世纪初，荷兰人来到南亚沿海后，便决心取代葡萄牙人，成为肉桂贸易的主导者。

grammar.type: when 时间从句 + 动名词宾语
grammar.note: When 从句说明时间；set their sights on 后接动名词 displacing，表示“决心实现”。

sentences.en: The Dutch allied themselves with Kandy, an inland kingdom on Ceylon.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人与锡兰内陆王国康提结盟。

grammar.type: 同位语
grammar.note: an inland kingdom on Ceylon 是 Kandy 的同位语；ally oneself with 表示“与……结盟”。

sentences.en: In return for payments of elephants and cinnamon, they protected the native king from the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 当地国王以大象和肉桂作为报酬，荷兰人则保护他免受葡萄牙人的威胁。

grammar.type: 介词短语状语
grammar.note: In return for... 表示交换条件；protect sb from... 表示“保护某人免受……伤害”。

sentences.en: By 1640, the Dutch broke the 150-year Portuguese monopoly when they overran and occupied their factories.
sentences.zh: 到1640年，荷兰人攻占葡萄牙人的工厂，打破了葡萄牙长达150年的垄断。

grammar.type: when 时间从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.note: when they overran and occupied... 说明垄断被打破的具体事件；overran 与 occupied 并列。

sentences.en: By 1658, they had permanently expelled the Portuguese from the island, thereby gaining control of the lucrative cinnamon trade.
sentences.zh: 到1658年，荷兰人已把葡萄牙人彻底赶出该岛，从而控制了利润丰厚的肉桂贸易。

grammar.type: 过去完成时 + 分词结果状语
grammar.note: had expelled 表示截至1658年已完成；thereby gaining... 说明这一行动的结果。

sentences.en: In order to protect their hold on the market, the Dutch, like the Portuguese before them, treated the native inhabitants harshly.
sentences.zh: 为了保住市场控制权，荷兰人和此前的葡萄牙人一样，严酷地对待当地居民。

grammar.type: 不定式目的状语 + 插入比较
grammar.note: In order to... 表目的；like the Portuguese before them 为插入的比较成分。

sentences.en: Because of the need to boost production and satisfy Europe's ever-increasing appetite for cinnamon, the Dutch began to alter the harvesting practices of the Ceylonese.
sentences.zh: 为了提高产量并满足欧洲不断增长的肉桂需求，荷兰人开始改变锡兰人的采收方式。

grammar.type: because of 原因状语 + 并列不定式
grammar.note: Because of 后接名词 the need；to boost 与 satisfy 并列修饰 need；began to alter 为主句谓语。

sentences.en: Over time, the supply of cinnamon trees on the island became nearly exhausted, due to systematic stripping of the bark.
sentences.zh: 由于人们有计划地不断剥取树皮，岛上的肉桂树逐渐接近枯竭。

grammar.type: 主系表 + 原因状语
grammar.note: became nearly exhausted 为系表结构；due to... 说明树木枯竭的原因。

sentences.en: Eventually, the Dutch began cultivating their own cinnamon trees to supplement the diminishing number of wild trees available for use.
sentences.zh: 最后，荷兰人开始自行种植肉桂树，以补充数量不断减少的野生树木。

grammar.type: 动名词宾语 + 不定式目的状语
grammar.note: began cultivating 表示“开始种植”；to supplement... 表目的；available for use 修饰 wild trees。

sentences.en: Then, in 1796, the English arrived on Ceylon, thereby displacing the Dutch from their control of the cinnamon monopoly.
sentences.zh: 1796年，英国人来到锡兰，取代荷兰人控制了肉桂垄断贸易。

grammar.type: 分词结果状语
grammar.note: thereby displacing... 说明英国人到来产生的结果；displace sb from... 表示把某人从某位置取代。

sentences.en: By the middle of the 19th century, production of cinnamon reached 1,000 tons a year, after a lower grade quality of the spice became acceptable to European tastes.
sentences.zh: 到19世纪中叶，品质较低的肉桂也开始被欧洲消费者接受，肉桂年产量达到1,000吨。

grammar.type: after 时间状语从句
grammar.note: 主句说明产量；after 从句说明低等级肉桂被接受这一先行变化；became acceptable 为系表结构。

sentences.en: By that time, cinnamon was being grown in other parts of the Indian Ocean region and in the West Indies, Brazil, and Guyana.
sentences.zh: 到那时，印度洋其他地区以及西印度群岛、巴西和圭亚那也开始种植肉桂。

grammar.type: 过去进行时被动
grammar.note: was being grown 表示在当时正在扩展中的被动动作；两个 in 短语列出种植地区。

sentences.en: Not only was a monopoly of cinnamon becoming impossible, but the spice trade overall was diminishing in economic potential, and was eventually superseded by the rise of trade in coffee, tea, chocolate, and sugar.
sentences.zh: 肉桂垄断不仅已无法维持，整个香料贸易的经济价值也在下降，并最终被咖啡、茶、巧克力和糖贸易的兴起所取代。

grammar.type: not only 倒装 + 并列被动
grammar.note: Not only 位于句首，引起 was a monopoly... 倒装；but 后有 was diminishing 与 was superseded 两个并列谓语。

questions.title: Questions 10-13 · TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN
instructions: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?

items.prompt: The Portuguese had control over the cinnamon trade in Ceylon throughout the 16th century.
The Dutch took over the cinnamon trade from the Portuguese as soon as they arrived in Ceylon.
The trees planted by the Dutch produced larger quantities of cinnamon than the wild trees.
The spice trade maintained its economic importance during the 19th century.
